name: MetricGroup
description: Mortar application metric group with optional icons, previous values and trend arrows; shared borders by default or separate cards, using central semantic tokens.

props.label: string
props.items: { label: string; value: string; change?: string; tone?: Tone; icon?: ReactNode; trend?: "up" | "down"; previous?: string }[] (trend adds an arrow and announces Increased/Decreased by; previous renders "from …")

contract.usage: Import { MetricGroup } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
